cost_model.notes: 24bp RT pair cost = (fee + slip) × 2 per side of pair, deducted at entry+exit bars in pnl_pct_per_bar to match freqtrade pair-cost convention. Total of 24.0bp drained from each trade's equity-walk PnL.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tightentry_longlookback_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tighter entry (z=3.0) + long z-window (200) + smooth funding (EMA 24 ≈ 6h) + detrended perp-index basis. Max-quality selection; expect very few trades but cleanest signal.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tighterentry_baselookback_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tighter entry (z=2.5) + baseline z-window (96) + smooth funding (EMA 24) + perp-index basis. 4-axis change from baseline; tests if perpendicular-axis combination yields an edge the old single-axis walk missed.

pre_registered_candidates.label: moderateentry_longlookback_smoothfunding_twoperp
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Moderate entry (z=2.0) + long z-window (200) + smooth funding (EMA 48 ≈ 12h) + two-perp basis (percentage spread). Detrended percentage spread gives a slower, lower-variance z signal.

pre_registered_candidates.label: baseline_axis_smoothfunding_only
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Baseline (z_entry=2.0, z_window=96, exit=0.5, perp_spot) + only the funding_ema_window change (48). Minimal-axis probe: tests if smoother funding alone (no other axes moved) clears the gate.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tighterentry_midlookback_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=2.5) + mid z-window (120) + smooth funding (EMA 48) + perp-index basis. Balanced 4-axis mid-corner probe.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tighterentry_shortlookback_smoothfunding_perpspot
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=2.5) + short z-window (60) + smooth funding (EMA 12 ≈ 3h) + perp_spot basis. Tests the high-turnover end: can the strategy survive short-window z-score if funding filter is smoother?

pre_registered_candidates.label: tightentry_midlookback_wideexit_smoothfunding_twoperp
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=3.0) + mid z-window (120) + wide exit (0.8) + smooth funding (EMA 48) + two-perp basis. Captures deep mean reversion on percentage-spread basis.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tighterentry_baselookback_smoothfunding_verytightexit_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=2.5) + baseline z-window (96) + smooth funding (EMA 48) + perp-index basis + tight exit (0.3). Captures sharp reversion early.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tightestentry_longlookback_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Extreme tight entry (z=3.0) + long z-window (200) + smooth funding (EMA 48) + perp-index basis. Rarest, highest-quality setups corner; expect very few trades.

pre_registered_candidates.label: moderateentry_baselookback_wideexit_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Moderate entry (z=2.0) + baseline z-window (96) + wide exit (0.8) + smooth funding (EMA 24) + perp-index basis. Wider tradable window, captures more mean reversion on detrended signal.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tighterentry_baselookback_rawfunding_tightexit_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=2.5) + baseline z-window (96) + raw funding (EMA 1) + perp-index basis + tight exit (0.3). Isolates basis_calc_method axis; everything else baseline-aligned.

pre_registered_candidates.label: tightentry_midlookback_smoothfunding_perpindex
pre_registered_candidates.rationale: Tight entry (z=3.0) + mid z-window (120) + smooth funding (EMA 24) + perp-index basis. Tight-entry corner with intermediate window; 4-axis change.

anti_overfit_notes: Pre-registered candidate set chosen a priori on economic reasoning;
no variant parameters were tuned based on OOS Sharpe readings.
All non-clone variants differ from baseline on ≥3 of 5 axes → unique
equity curves guaranteed by the trade-list SHA-256 anti-clone guard.
DSR penalty applied with n_trials = len(pre_registered_candidates).
The full 432-cell Cartesian product was NOT searched.
Cost model: 24bp RT pair cost applied in equity walk matches the
freqtrade validator convention; closes the in-house / freqtrade
